validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE + CLASSIFICATION confirmed. GEM's sole citation is a single contractor/project page (iranertebat.com '48-Inch Gas Transmission Pipeline', 9 backlinks) — a single-source row, so I re-verified independently. This is a real, in-service line: Iran's 'Fifth Tehran Gas Transmission Line' (خط پنجم انتقال گاز تهران), a 48-inch domestic GAS TRANSMISSION trunk that runs from near Parchin (SE Tehran) via Mamlou Dam, Baghkomsh village, Jajrud, a cement factory and Khojir National Park to km 29 of Shahid Babaei Expressway (NE Tehran), supplying northern/northeastern Tehran, Lavasanat and the towns of Boumehen, Roudehen, Damavand and Firuzkuh. Inaugurated Azar 1387 (Nov/Dec 2008) by Oil Minister Nozari with the CEO of the National Iranian Gas Company and Tehran Province Gas Co. INDEPENDENT corroboration (citable): Shana (Oil Ministry news agency) news/454413 references 'the fifth Tehran line' (خط لوله پنجم تهران) as an existing line paralleled by the new Mohammadieh-Qom-Parchin 56-inch reinforcement, serving the same Boumehen/Damavand/Pardis corridor — confirming both existence and that it is a Tehran-province gas transmission line, independent of iranertebat and of GEM. Classification 'transmission' / Fuel 'Gas' both correct. DUPLICATE check: no match in the Iran gas roster (P6027 Kuh Sefid–Charmshahr is a separate 56-inch Tehran line; the Mohammadieh-Qom-Parchin 56-inch reinforcement is a distinct parallel line, not this one) and no counterpart in the GulfPub Iran gas roster — not a duplicate. Caveat: detailed specs (corridor, capacity, inauguration) trace to one origin (iranertebat, which times out and could not pass url_verifier so is not cited); Shana is the one citable independent confirmation of existence.

validity.researcher_notes: OWNER likely mis-attributed. GEM lists Owner1 = National Iranian Oil Co (100%). This is a domestic gas transmission/city-supply line: it was inaugurated by the CEO of the National Iranian GAS Company (شرکت ملی گاز ایران) and the Tehran Province Gas Company, and Iran's domestic gas transmission network is owned/operated by NIGC and its subsidiary the Iranian Gas Transmission Company — not NIOC, which handles upstream oil and gas production. GulfPub tags most Iran national lines to NIOC generically, but for a Tehran city-supply transmission line NIGC/IGTC is correct. Medium confidence: the inaugurating parties (NIGC + Tehran gas co) are documented; exact owning entity (NIGC vs Iranian Gas Transmission Co vs Tehran Province Gas Co) not pinned to a single citable source here.

validity.researcher_notes: SPEC discrepancies. (1) CAPACITY: GEM = 204 MMcf/d. The line's own described throughput is 'one million five hundred thousand cubic meters per hour' (1,500,000 m3/h) at the end of the fifth line — = 36,000,000 m3/day = 36 MMcm/d ~= 1,271 MMcf/d, i.e. GEM's 204 is roughly one-sixth of the figure in its own (and the corroborating) source, and neither a /day misread (1.5 MCM/d ~= 53 MMcf/d) nor other simple conversion yields 204. Flagged, not silently passed. Only one origin (iranertebat, republished) gives the 1.5 MCM/h figure, so tier is medium and I did not restage a corrected number. (2) DIAMETER 48 in: CONFIRMED (48-inch line, multiple mentions). (3) START 2008: CONFIRMED (Azar 1387 = Nov/Dec 2008 inauguration). (4) LENGTH 35 km: consistent with the Parchin→km-29-Shahid-Babaei corridor via Mamlou Dam/Jajrud/Khojir (straight-line ~28-30 km; winding ~35 km) but not independently pinned to an exact figure. (5) DATA GLITCH: the value '2006' sits in the ProposalMonth column with ProposalYear blank — a year mis-entered into the month field; 2006 as the proposal year is also not independently confirmed here.

routes.corridor_desc: Runs entirely within Tehran province along the eastern side of greater Tehran. Starts near Parchin (SE, where it ties into the national grid / the parallel Mohammadieh-Qom-Parchin feed), crosses/skirts Mamlou Dam on the Jajrud river, passes Baghkomsh village, Jajrud, a cement factory and Khojir National Park, and terminates at km 29 of Shahid Babaei Expressway in NE Tehran, feeding the northern/northeastern Tehran, Lavasanat, Boumehen, Roudehen, Damavand and Firuzkuh supply areas. Corridor of named waypoints is well-bounded; endpoint coordinates are place-centroid APPROXIMATIONS (EPSG:4326), not surveyed pipeline coordinates — the km-29 Shahid Babaei terminus and Parchin origin are named but not pinned to meter accuracy.
routes.researcher_notes: Endpoints and waypoint sequence (Parchin → Mamlou Dam → Baghkomsh → Jajrud → cement factory → Khojir NP → km 29 Shahid Babaei) come from the iranertebat project page (surfaced via search; the domain times out and did not pass url_verifier, so it is not cited); Shana (citable, passed verifier with tokens 'خط لوله پنجم تهران', 'پارچین', 'پردیس') independently confirms the fifth Tehran line and the Parchin / NE-Tehran (Boumehen/Damavand/Pardis) corridor. Coordinates are approximate centroids of the named places; none fabricated — no meter-level survey coords are available, so precision is capped at 'medium'. Not for auto-apply; a human routes-repo branch should trace the corridor against the named waypoints.

summary: P6026 is real and correctly classified as a Tehran-province gas transmission trunk (Iran's 'Fifth Tehran Gas Transmission Line', Parchin→km-29 Shahid Babaei, 48-inch, in service since 2008); no duplicate. Concerns: owner is NIOC but should be NIGC/Iranian Gas Transmission Co (attribution), and Capacity 204 MMcf/d is ~6x below the sourced 1.5 MMcm/h (~1,271 MMcf/d) figure (spec); ProposalYear/Month mis-entered.
